dialPubFp.description: Fingerprint of the BFF dial PUBLIC key (private key lives in Vault).

vaultRef.description: Vault POINTER to the private dial key (a reference, never key bytes).

k8sSecretName.description: K8s Secret NAME the private key is synced into (a name, never bytes).

DeviceSshDialResponse.description: Non-secret device dial row (status/generation/pins/pointers) — never key bytes.

stepUpToken.description: Opaque single-use step-up token; present on the X-Device-Terminal-StepUp header (CLI) or the hugmesh.device-terminal.stepup.<token> subprotocol (browser).

DesktopTerminalStepUpResponse.description: The minted desktop step-up token + its TTL (for the SSH-terminal handshake and the remote-install header).

dark.description: True while the live transport ships dark (app.device-terminal.enabled=false).

wsPath.description: The real live WS handshake path (/bff/admin/device-terminal/{deviceId}).

stepUpRequired.description: Whether the WS handshake requires a step-up token (always true).

DesktopSshSessionDescriptor.description: Pre-WS descriptor: the real device-terminal WebSocket path + dark flag + step-up requirement (the UI's source of the live coordinates).
